```css
1div {
2    background-image: url('/images/learn-css/bg.png');
3
4   /* Don't repeat the background image. */
5   background-repeat: no-repeat;
6}
```

Browser Output

![Background: No Repeat](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, the background doesn't repeat.

However, since the image size is smaller than the targeted element, the design doesn't look good.

In such a scenario, you need to stretch the background to ensure it covers the entire screen.

There is an easy way to fix this issue using the background-size property.
